title: Claim Social Security at 62? Waiting Pays 77% More
description: For anyone born in 1960 or later, claiming Social Security at 62 pays about 70% of the full benefit, while waiting until 70 pays about 124%. That is roughly 77% more each month. Your benefit depends on your work record. Educational only, not financial advice. #socialsecurity #retirementplanning #shorts

title: Nvidia Was Born in a Denny's Booth
description: In 1993 Jensen Huang, Chris Malachowsky and Curtis Priem planned Nvidia at a Denny's in San Jose. In October 2025 Nvidia became the first company valued at $5 trillion. #nvidia #entrepreneur #shorts
